title: Iterative Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Medical Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2604.27724v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Medical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems typically operate on text chunks extracted from biomedical literature, discarding the rich visual content (tables, figures, structured layouts) of original document pages. We propose MED-VRAG, an iterative multimodal RAG framework that retrieves and reasons over PMC document page images instead of OCR'd text. The system pairs ColQwen2.5 patch-level page embeddings with a sharded MapReduce LLM filter, scaling to ~350K pages while keeping Stage-1 retrieval under 30 ms via an offline coarse-to-fine index (C=8 centroids per page, ANN over centroids, exact two-way scoring on the top-R shortlist). A vision-language model (VLM) then iteratively refines its query and accumulates evidence in a memory bank across up to 3 reasoning rounds, with a single iteration costing ~15.9 s and the full three-round pipeline ~47.8 s on 4xA100. translated_title: 面向医学问答的迭代式多模态检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 医学检索增强生成（RAG）系统通常在从生物医学文献中提取的文本片段上运行，丢弃了原始文档页面中丰富的视觉内容（表格、图表、结构化布局）。我们提出了MED-VRAG，这是一个迭代式多模态RAG框架，它直接检索PMC文档页面图像而非OCR文本，并基于图像进行推理。该系统将ColQwen2.5补丁级页面嵌入与分片MapReduce大语言模型过滤器相结合，可扩展至约35万页面规模，同时通过离线粗到细索引（每页C=8个质心、质心上的近似最近邻搜索、对top-R候选列表进行精确双向评分），将第一阶段检索延迟保持在30毫秒以内。随后，视觉语言模型（VLM）在最多3轮推理中迭代地细化查询并在记忆库中积累证据，单次迭代成本约为15.9秒，在4块A100上完整的三轮流程耗时约47.8秒。在四个医学问答基准（MedQA、MedMCQA、PubMedQA、M……）上进行了评估。
tldr: 提出MED-VRAG框架，通过直接检索和推理PMC文档页面图像（而非OCR文本）并结合迭代式多轮证据积累机制，实现了高效且准确的医学问答。
en_tdlr: MED-VRAG is an iterative multimodal RAG framework that retrieves and reasons over PMC document page images instead of OCR'd text, combining fast coarse-to-fine indexing with multi-round VLM query refinement and evidence accumulation for accurate medical question answering.
